interest: Reveals Allied economic intelligence tracking Japan's chemical vulnerabilities, wartime industrial conversions, and fertiliser shortages affecting food production.
overview: This file contains diplomatic despatches, intelligence reports, telegrams, and inter-agency memoranda detailing Japan's chemical and manufacturing industries between 1940 and 1943. It focuses on Japanese industrial capacities, agricultural fertiliser supplies, strategic material vulnerabilities such as potash and carbon black, corporate conversions to military production, and Anglo-American economic intelligence coordination with the British Ministry of Economic Warfare.
